1.title: Visiting the Museum of Nature and Wildlife
1.intro: Maryam is visiting the Museum of Nature and Wildlife. She's talking to Mr. Razavi, who works in the museum.

lines.speaker: Maryam
lines.text: Excuse me, what is it? Is it a leopard?

lines.speaker: Mr. Razavi
lines.text: No, it is a cheetah.

lines.speaker: Maryam
lines.text: Oh, a cheetah?

lines.speaker: Mr. Razavi
lines.text: Yeah, an Iranian cheetah. It is an endangered animal.

lines.speaker: Maryam
lines.text: I know. I heard around 70 of them are alive. Yes?

lines.speaker: Mr. Razavi
lines.text: Right, but the number will increase.

lines.speaker: Maryam
lines.text: Really?! How?

lines.speaker: Mr. Razavi
lines.text: Well, we have some plans. For example, we are going to protect their homes, to make movies about their life, and to teach people how to take more care of them.

questions: Do you take care of animals?

2.title: Visiting Iranian National Observatory
2.intro: Alireza is visiting an observatory. He is talking to Ms. Tabesh who works there.

lines.speaker: Ms. Tabesh
lines.text: Are you interested in the planets?

lines.speaker: Alireza
lines.text: Yes! They are really interesting for me, but I don't know much about them.

lines.speaker: Ms. Tabesh
lines.text: Planets are really amazing but not so much alike. Do you know how they are different?

lines.speaker: Alireza
lines.text: Umm... I know they go around the Sun in different orbits.

lines.speaker: Ms. Tabesh
lines.text: That's right. They have different colors and sizes, too. Some are rocky like Mars, some have rings like Saturn and some have moons like Uranus.

lines.speaker: Alireza
lines.text: How wonderful! Can we see them without a telescope?

lines.speaker: Ms. Tabesh
lines.text: Yeah..., we can see the planets nearer to us without a telescope, such as Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn. We can see Uranus and Neptune only with powerful telescopes.

lines.speaker: Alireza
lines.text: And which planet is the largest of all?

lines.speaker: Ms. Tabesh
lines.text: Jupiter is the largest one. It has more than sixty moons. Do you want to look at it?

lines.speaker: Alireza
lines.text: I really like that.

questions: Can we see all planets without a telescope?
Do you know the names of the planets in Persian?

3.title: Talking about Famous Iranian Scientists
3.intro: Roya and Mahsa are leaving the library.

lines.speaker: Roya
lines.text: When I came in, you were reading a book. What was it?

lines.speaker: Mahsa
lines.text: I was reading a book about famous Iranian scientists.

lines.speaker: Roya
lines.text: But such books are not very interesting.

lines.speaker: Mahsa
lines.text: At first I had the same idea, believe me!

lines.speaker: Roya
lines.text: Did you find it useful?

lines.speaker: Mahsa
lines.text: Oh yes. Actually I learned many interesting things about our scientists' lives.

lines.speaker: Roya
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Mahsa
lines.text: For example Razi taught medicine to many young people while he was working in Ray Hospital. Or Nasireddin Toosi built Maragheh Observatory when he was studying the planets.

lines.speaker: Roya
lines.text: Cool! What was the name of the book?

lines.speaker: Mahsa
lines.text: Famous Iranian Scientists.

questions: Were Mahsa and Roya in a laboratory?
Who came to the library sooner, Mahsa or Roya?
Do you know any interesting story about famous scientists?

4.title: Finding a Good Tourist Destination
4.intro: Diego is a Spanish tourist who is planning for his summer vacation. He is talking to Carlos Sabato, a travel agent in Madrid.

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.text: Excuse me, sir! I am planning for my summer vacation.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.text: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.text: Actually I want to visit Asia, but I am not sure about my destination. Do you have any suggestion?

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.text: Well, you may have some choices. You can visit China. It is famous for the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.text: Yes, but I was in Beijing two years ago.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.text: What about India? In fact, the Taj Mahal is a popular destination, but it is hot in summer. Probably Iran is the best choice.

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.text: I heard Iran is a great and beautiful country, but I don't know much about it.

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.text: Well, Iran is a four-season country. It has many historical sites and amazing nature. Also, its people are very kind and hospitable.

lines.speaker: Diego
lines.text: It seems a suitable choice. But how can I get more information about Iran?

lines.speaker: Carlos
lines.text: You can check this booklet or may see our website.

questions: Where do you want to go for your vacation?
